definitions.explanation: A net on a long handle for catching insects such as butterflies, dragonflies and cicadas. A familiar part of Japanese childhood summers, along with an insect cage.

examples.japanese: {虫取|むしと}り{網|あみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧。
{虫取|むしと}り{網|あみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧トンボ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえた→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧。
examples.english: I caught a dragonfly with an insect net.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{虫取|むしと}り{網|あみ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{虫|むし}かご→虫かご：32615_mushikago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: When summer vacation comes, children head to the park with insect nets and insect cages.

notes:
Made of ⟦{虫取|むしと}り→虫取り：32645_mushitori⟧ (insect catching) + ⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧ (net). Also written {虫捕|むしと}り⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧.
